title: Hawaii Conditions MCP Server
description: Real-time surf, weather, trail status, volcano, ocean safety, and restaurants for Hawaii.
summary: Real-time surf, weather, trail status, volcano, ocean safety, and restaurants for Hawaii.
offersHint: Real-time surf, weather, trail status, volcano, ocean safety, and restaurants for Hawaii. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://hawaii-conditions.vercel.app/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: ping
toolsPreview.description: Health check — returns server status. Free.

toolsPreview.name: register_agent
toolsPreview.description: Create a prepaid account. Returns api_key (format: mcp_live_…). Store it immediately — shown only once. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_balance
toolsPreview.description: Returns current balance, original load amount, and low-balance flag. Free.

toolsPreview.name: create_wallet_setup
toolsPreview.description: Initialise Stripe SetupIntent — returns client_secret for saving a card. Free.

toolsPreview.name: save_payment_method
toolsPreview.description: Attach a Stripe payment method (pm_…) to your account for autonomous top-ups. Free.

toolsPreview.name: link_stripe_customer
toolsPreview.description: Link an existing Stripe customer ID (cus_…) to your account. Free.

toolsPreview.name: recent_transactions
toolsPreview.description: View recent credits and debits (default 20, max 50). Free.

toolsPreview.name: add_funds_5
toolsPreview.description: Charge your saved card $5 — balance credited after Stripe payment confirmation. Free to call.

toolsPreview.name: add_funds_10
toolsPreview.description: Charge your saved card $10 — balance credited after Stripe payment confirmation. Free to call.

toolsPreview.name: add_funds_20
toolsPreview.description: Charge your saved card $20 — balance credited after Stripe payment confirmation. Free to call.

toolsPreview.name: get_sun_times
toolsPreview.description: Sunrise, sunset, and daylight duration by island (HST). Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_moon_phase
toolsPreview.description: Current moon phase, illumination percentage, moonrise/moonset times, and days to next full/new moon. Free.

toolsPreview.name: get_weather
toolsPreview.description: 5-day forecast, UV index, wind, sunrise/sunset. Cost: $0.10.

toolsPreview.name: get_surf_conditions
toolsPreview.description: Wave height, period, direction + 3-day forecast. Cost: $0.10.

toolsPreview.name: get_trail_status
toolsPreview.description: NPS alerts and state trail closures. Cost: $0.25.

toolsPreview.name: get_volcano_status
toolsPreview.description: Live Kīlauea status from USGS HVO. Cost: $0.25.

toolsPreview.name: get_ocean_safety
toolsPreview.description: Box jellyfish, rip currents, NOAA marine alerts. Cost: $0.50.

toolsPreview.name: get_full_briefing
toolsPreview.description: All five data sources combined — weather, surf, trails, volcano, ocean safety. Best value at $2.00.

toolsPreview.name: search_restaurants
toolsPreview.description: Find restaurants by location, cuisine, price range, open-now filter. Cost: $0.25.

toolsPreview.name: get_restaurant_details
toolsPreview.description: Full hours, reviews, photos for a restaurant by place_id. Cost: $0.15.
